searchText: This Berlin fork status monitor has me concerned since a lot of bigger players (e.g. mining pools) haven't indicated support for Berlin. https://ethernodes.org/berlin Is there better info somewhere else or is everyone just feeling ok about this from your contact with "the community". Given that has no information on Infura who will definitely be ready I suspect ethernodes just doesn't have the info. Bitfly's news feed says to update your nodes for Berlin so I guess that means they support it. It sounds like Coinbase maybe supports it? They are "monitoring" the network during the upgrade. https://status.coinbase.com/ We're ready. The devs have contacted pools in the background. What Adrian said 🙂 😅
